purpose: How the dashboard's Run QA may start a signed-in session. Read by src/lambda_function.py at import and by tests/test_run_qa_switch.py and tests/test_run_qa_lease.py. Shipped next to lambda_function.py by deploy/deploy.sh and cdk/stack.py.

enable.why: Kill switch: the owner can turn Run QA off without a code change.

qualifier.why: Harness endpoint to invoke (plan WS3). Dormant: when unset, invoke_harness gets no qualifier, which is today's behaviour.

lease.why: One signed-in UI QA run at a time on the shared UI harness and QA logins, shared with the CI loop (token-monitoring feature-53). The rules are harness_lock_spec.json, vendored next to this file.
lease.busyStatus: busy: the UI harness lease is held by another run
lease.lostNote: the harness lease was lost mid-run; the password is still valid until the next rotation

rotation.why: broker: rotate the login before the harness call and again in finally, so the password the model typed is dead when the run ends (qa_reset_broker_spec.json is the request format). manual: take the lease but do not rotate; the owner rotates.
